task_summary: Armed a decoupled user-manager transient unit to restart novacore-watcher (reopening the 8-day-empty watcher.log via the already-landed RotatingFileHandler fix) and archive the orphaned watcher.log.1, executed outside the watcher cgroup so it survives the restart and waits for task 1052 to finalize first.
